stories.title: Payments are atomic and the invoice balance is always collectable, even after interim checkpoints
stories.story: As the billing desk I want every payment to add exactly once to the invoice and the invoice status to follow its real balance, so that a dental visit paid at an interim stop can still collect the later procedure charge and two cashiers can never lose a payment.
stories.context: Today CheckoutService.recordPayment reads invoices.paid, adds in Java and writes an absolute value (QA-11), so two simultaneous payments lose one. CheckoutRepository.updateInvoiceTotals changes totals at a later billing checkpoint but never recomputes status, so an invoice paid in full at billing_pending stays 'paid' after a procedure is appended and the next payment is refused with invoice-already-paid (QA-10, journey J11). The fix: lock the invoice row (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) or use UPDATE invoices SET paid = paid + :amt ... RETURNING, derive paid from SUM(invoice_payments.amount) and recompute status (unpaid / partial / paid) on every change of total or payments. Overpayment is rejected (no change-giving through the system; change is a cash-drawer matter). A payment against a cancelled or fully-refunded invoice is refused. Unblocks the reception and solo personas for the pilot; prerequisite for refunds, payment links and day close accuracy.

Given an invoice fully paid at an interim billing_pending checkpoint, when a 1,200 INR procedure is appended at checkout_pending, then status becomes 'partial', balance = 1,200 and a further payment of 1,200 is accepted (J11 green, < 90 s end to end)
Given an invoice with balance 200, when a payment of 250 is posted, then the API returns 422 overpayment with the current balance and no payment row is written
Given any invoice, when totals or payments change, then status is recomputed in the same transaction from paid vs total (never stored stale)
Given a nightly consistency job, when it compares invoices.paid with SUM(invoice_payments.amount) per tenant, then mismatches = 0 and any mismatch raises an alert

stories.title: Gapless invoice, credit-note and receipt series per GSTIN/VAT number, branch and financial year, with currency on every money header
stories.story: As the billing desk I want each invoice to take the next number in its own series for our GSTIN (or VAT number) and financial year, with the currency printed, so that our invoices pass a GST or VAT audit.
stories.context: Today invoices.invoice_number defaults to a global sequence 'INV-' || invoices_number_seq shared by all tenants (gaps and cross-tenant interleaving), package credit notes use another global sequence, and the invoice_series table (V41, keyed by tenant + tax_registration + kind + fiscal_year) is unused. GST rule 46 needs consecutive serial numbers unique per financial year (max 16 characters); ZATCA needs a sequential counter per device too (handled in FIN-050). Numbers are allocated by UPDATE invoice_series SET next_number = next_number + 1 ... RETURNING inside the invoice transaction (row lock = gapless, numbers allocated only on commit). The series is per facility (tenant = branch) and per tax registration, so a 3-branch owner with one GSTIN gets three independent series (multi-branch lite T-332). The Indian FY rolls on 1 April; GCC series roll on 1 January (configurable). Monetary headers (invoices, invoice_payments, package_instances, package_refunds, day_closes) get currency char(3) derived from the tax registration's jurisdiction, and amounts move to minor-unit bigint columns (expand/contract: dual-write, then switch reads) so KWD/BHD/OMR 3-decimal currencies work. Per-tenant MRN (T-107 AC) is delivered by the patient domain; this story only consumes it.

Given any monetary header row, then currency is non-null char(3) and amount_minor = amount x 10^exponent(currency)

stories.title: Tax engine core: discount allocated to lines before tax, market rounding and a stored tax breakdown
stories.story: As the billing desk I want tax computed per line on the discounted value with the right rounding for our currency, so that we never over-collect tax and invoices add up exactly.
stories.context: QA-13: computeTotals charges tax on unitPrice x qty and then subtracts an invoice-level discount, so INR 1,000 at 18% with INR 100 discount gives tax 180 instead of 162; totals round to whole units even for SAR. The engine (billing/internal/tax) takes a cart (lines with taxable category, rate inputs, place of supply, patient attributes) and returns per-line taxable value, tax components and totals. Invoice-level discounts are allocated across discountable lines pro rata to line value (largest-remainder to keep minor units exact); line discounts apply first. Rounding: per-line tax rounded half-up to minor unit; INR invoice total may round to the nearest rupee with a round-off line (allowed under GST); SAR/AED/QAR keep 2 decimals with no whole-unit rounding. The engine is a port (TaxEngine) with jurisdiction adapters: IndiaGst (FIN-009), UaeVat (FIN-045), KsaVat (FIN-048), QatarNoVat; the tax rule tables are versioned reference data with effective dates so rate changes (e.g. GST rationalisation of 22 Sep 2025) apply to new bills only. Each invoice line stores its tax components so reprints never recompute.
acceptance: Given INR 1,000 at 18% and an INR 100 invoice discount, then taxable value = 900 and tax = 162 (QA-13 regression)
Given three lines (exempt 500, 18% 1,000, 5% 200) and a 170 discount, then the discount is allocated 50 / 100 / 20 and taxes are computed on the reduced values, sum of allocations = 170 exactly
Given a SAR invoice, then the total keeps 2 decimals and no whole-unit round-off line is produced
Given a rate change effective tomorrow, when a bill is created today, then today's rate is used; a reprint of yesterday's invoice shows the stored rate
Given any invoice, then SUM(line taxable + line tax) + round_off = total to the minor unit (invariant checked in tests and nightly)

stories.context: Healthcare services by a clinical establishment are exempt (SAC 9993), cosmetic and aesthetic procedures are taxable at 18% (reconstructive stays exempt), and medicines/consumables carry HSN-wise rates (commonly 5%, 12% or 0%; after the Sep 2025 rationalisation most medicines are 5% or nil). charge_catalogue today has tax_code (label), tax_rate_percent and hsn_code (pharmacy only). This story adds a tax_category per head (exempt / nil / taxable) plus SAC/HSN, a guided picker in the price master ('Is this cosmetic or aesthetic?' -> 18%, 'reconstructive?' -> exempt), and the IndiaGst adapter: intra-state supply -> CGST + SGST (half each), inter-state -> IGST (place of supply = clinic state for services; for goods sold to an out-of-state B2B buyer with GSTIN -> IGST). The clinic's GSTIN and state code come from tax_registrations; an unregistered clinic (below threshold) issues a 'Bill of Supply' with no tax lines. HSN-wise summary is kept for the invoice and returns export.

Given a B2B buyer GSTIN from another state buying a medicine at 5%, then IGST 5% is applied
Given an unregistered clinic (no GSTIN), then documents are titled 'Bill of Supply' and carry no tax lines
Given a new charge head, when the owner answers the guided picker, then category, SAC/HSN and rate are set and the owner sees the effect in the preview
Given 100% of the CA worked examples for India (FIN-010), then outputs match

stories.story: As the billing desk I want to refund a payment or cancel a charge with a reason, have it approved by someone else, and get a tax credit note automatically, so that mistakes are reversible and the books stay right.

stories.title: Package invoices split the bundle price across components with each line's own tax, and refunds reverse per line

stories.title: Signed UBL invoices: simplified invoices reported within 24 hours, standard invoices cleared before sharing
stories.story: As a KSA billing desk I want every invoice, credit note and debit note signed and sent to ZATCA automatically — patient bills reported within 24 hours and B2B bills cleared before I hand them over — so that 100% of invoices are compliant.

Standard (B2B, e.g. to insurers/corporates) invoices are sent to the Clearance API and only the cleared XML/PDF (with ZATCA stamp) is shared. ICV and PIH are updated in the same transaction as the invoice issue under a per-EGS row lock so the chain never forks. Credit/debit notes reference the original invoice and a reason. Uses einvoice_documents (regime SA_ZATCA) and the shared retry worker.

Given a standard invoice to an insurer, then it is cleared before the PDF is available to share and the shared PDF carries the cleared QR
